notes: English antenatal booking note. Also carries dated vaccinations, vital signs, lab results, an alert and a plan of care (context only; the alert is not a problem). The atrial septal defect Q21 is the 'heart defect' option and SVT I47 the heart-disease option; the closure is part of the diagnosis line, and the caesarean is a procedure, not a problem. Supplements: folic acid, vitamin D, calcium, multivitamin. 'No known drug allergies.' (scope medication) stands next to a peanut allergy; the EpiPen, used only on a stated trigger (anaphylaxis), is as_needed (sv01 convention).
